content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education Organisational units Central Offices Centre for Student Advisory & Career Services Centre for Student Advisory & Career Services As a student advisory service and career service, we inform, advise, support and empower prospective and current students throughout the entire academic process, from choosing a degree programme and answering individual questions about the organisation of studies to subsequent career transition. We also provide support in sensitive circumstances and are there to help students overcome study-related difficulties. General Student Advisory Service Information & counselling for prospective students Career Services Counselling, workshops & practical insights for career orientation & career entry Psychological counselling Support with small and larger-scale crises during your studies Barrier-Free Education Support around studying with a disability
